notes.title: The new godot version is finally Finished!
notes.notes:
Thank you allot for waiting so long, I finally made it! I Finally finished the new Godot version!
AI Stories is now out of early access and fully released.

I hope that you will love what I created, have a lot of fun playing!
Emir Akyazi

notes.title: New Godot version is under Construction
notes.notes:
Hello.

Due to the recent events going on at Unity Technologies, makers of the Unity game engine which is used to make this game. I am currently completely rebuilding the Game inside the Godot Engine. I was already very close to finishing the Second Chapter, but then the story with Unity happened, and now I have to take the saver way and work with Godot.

The new Godot Version will feature way better and more fun Gameplay, seen in this little demonstration video.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KU0cjL4r9r0

You are also free to subscribe to the YouTube channel to see new devlog videos of AI Stories once they are out.

Don't worry, The world already looks more filled and fun than what is shown in the video. It's just a proof that I am still working on this project.

When the new version will be out, I will also change the tags and the description on the Steam page to fit to the new "style" the game has taken.

I will also provide a Soundtrack both on YouTube and here on Steam once the new version is out.

I hope that you will like the new Godot build of AI Stories and keep on having a wonderful time with the AIs.

Much love, Emir Akyazi.
